body: the sewing kit is tied to the hand radio by a clipped lanyard. an empty loop shows where an identifying tag was cut off.
title: missing count beside the sewing kit
rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
